name: sediment
description: Local-first Obsidian plugin: knowledge stats, heatmap, quick memos, weekly reviews and agent knowledge deposition.

scripts.dev: node scripts/version-bump.mjs && node scripts/sync-changelog.mjs && node scripts/sync-bridge.mjs && node esbuild.config.mjs
scripts.build: node scripts/version-bump.mjs && node scripts/sync-changelog.mjs && node scripts/sync-bridge.mjs && tsc --noEmit && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/package.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:lint-i18n && npm run test:unit && npm run test:mcp
scripts.version: node scripts/version-bump.mjs && git add package.json package-lock.json manifest.json versions.json mcp-server/index.mjs README.md
